input: verified Copilot call demand v2 five-day counts and fixed HGB q90 predictions
source_quality: all recorded call occurrences; prompt token null quality failure remains
target: max current 5-minute calls through READY bin; complete at origin+h+1
feedback: positive q90 of (completed target - raw prediction)/origin scale; multiply by current scale
baselines: train-weighted peak ratio q90, past-hour max/q90/mean; identical feedback for all four
selection: June6 calibrated baseline pinball only, saved before new test scoring
test: June7 already exposed in prior experiments; retrospective only
gate: model loss >=5% lower than validation-selected equally corrected baseline AND model coverage85..95%
scope: recorded sampled LLM call arrivals; no VM control, GPU demand or user SLO effects
